text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks B, C, D and E at gains was satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding against my portfolio needs.","After buying Stocks A, B, D and E, I should not let reluctance to admit a mistake keep me invested if the reasons for holding no longer make sense.","Recent swings did not provide a reliable forecast, and my periods of inactivity avoided unnecessary trading; I should keep decisions deliberate and grounded in risk and diversification."]}
